sources_inspected.label: National Archives, Bulletin 2015-01 Appendix A (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The National Archives metadata guidance identifies file name, unique record identifier, title, and creation date as record-description fields in its federal records context.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article borrows only the general locator principle of naming the reviewed file and displayed version or date; it does not claim that a private worksheet is a federal record or subject to NARA requirements.

sources_inspected.label: Microsoft Support, Overview of formulas in Excel (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Microsoft documents that a worksheet cell or range can be identified by a reference and that Excel supports A1 and R1C1 reference styles.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses this only to explain how to copy a visible worksheet location such as a tab and cell or range; it does not inspect formulas, recalculate values, or prescribe a workbook structure.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Online Research Queries (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission lists distinct oil-and-gas query systems, their update frequencies, and an informational-use disclaimer for online data sets.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses this only to show why a locator should preserve the exact displayed query or record reference and access context; it makes no owner-specific record match, title, ownership, production, payment, or value conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query System FAQs (accessed 2026-08-22)
